summary: Verified the new Data Freshness banner + SKU/barcode search fix. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass for /api/data-freshness shape + own-store=today + competitors=stale, plus 4 my-products search scenarios (exact SKU, partial prefix, regex-meta-char escape, name regression). Frontend: DataFreshnessBanner renders correctly on /, /price-intel, /scanner with bucket=stale, expand toggle works, 14 per-store rows with correct data-testid='freshness-store-{store_id}', own-store (Pets houses) shows TODAY, competitor stores show STALE with real ages (36-70 days), 'Next crawl in 11 hrs' visible, and the 11/13 stale fraction is shown.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration / HTML validity error in console: 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>'. The refresh button (data-testid='freshness-refresh-btn') is nested inside the toggle button (data-testid='data-freshness-toggle'). Browser auto-unnests so functionality works, but this fires a console error on every render of every page that mounts the banner (My Products / Price Intel / Scanner).

issues: The 'mm/dd/yyyy' date picker uses the browser-default <input type='date'> instead of the shadcn calendar component used elsewhere — minor inconsistency, not introduced by this iteration.

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/data-freshness → 200; response has overall + stores[] + next_run + crawl_paused + checked_at; all buckets ∈ {today,this_week,this_month,stale,no_data}
Backend: overall.bucket = 'stale', age_days = 70.2, competitor_store_count = 11, latest=2026-05-21, oldest=2026-04-18; own_store_last_sync = 2026-06-27 (today)
Backend: Own store 'Pets houses' is_own_store=true, bucket='today', age_days=0.1, snapshot_count=2086
Backend: Competitor stores all bucket='stale' (Petsy/aleef/Hobba 70.2d, CuteCat/CutePets/Mowkly 62d, Hamtaro 41.8d, Panda/Lana 37d, Zarafa/Caty 36d)
Backend: GET /api/my-products?search=8595602569199&days=90&limit=5 → exactly 1 product, SKU matches (Brit Care Cat Soup with Turkey) — previously returned 10 unrelated, now FIXED
Backend: GET /api/my-products?search=8005852&days=90&limit=10 → many products, every returned product's sku OR barcode contains '8005852' (Schesir products)
Backend: GET /api/my-products?search=.*&days=90&limit=5 → 0 wildcard leaks; regex meta-chars properly escaped via re.escape()
Backend: GET /api/my-products?search=Royal&days=90&limit=10 → ≥1 product with 'Royal' in name (Royal Canin) — name-search regression intact
Frontend: Login as super_admin → redirect to / (My Products)
Frontend [/]: Summary text contains 'Oldest competitor crawl: 70 days ago', 'Newest: 36 days ago', '11/13 stores stale', 'Next crawl: in 11 hrs'
Frontend [/]: Toggle button expands freshness-store-list; 14 rows with data-testid='freshness-store-{uuid}' (e.g. freshness-store-52684f49-8dcf-4d6c-97ac-4a87e65238eb for Pets houses)
Frontend [/]: Own-store row shows 'Pets houses' + MINE badge + '3 hrs ago' + TODAY pill (green)
Frontend [/]: Competitor rows show correct ages + STALE pill (red) for 11 stores; 2 placeholder stores (TEST_Regression_Store, Test Store) show 'no data'
Frontend [/price-intel]: Banner mounts; same bucket=stale, same per-store list when expanded
Frontend [/scanner]: Banner mounts; same bucket=stale, same per-store list when expanded
action_items: Fix nested-button DOM warning in DataFreshnessBanner: move the refresh icon out of the toggle <button>, or use a non-button wrapper (e.g. <div role='button' tabIndex={0}>) for the outer expand area, so refresh-btn is a sibling rather than a descendant of toggle. Currently triggers a React console error on every page that mounts the banner.
critical_code_review_comments: Search fix in /api/my-products is now using re.escape() on the user input and a $or across sku/barcode/name — correctly returns exactly 1 product for the exact SKU search, no longer matches everything on '.*', and preserves name-search regression. Verified across 4 test cases.

/api/data-freshness returns the exact shape spec'd, with 60s TTL cache. Bucketing thresholds appear correct given 36-70 day staleness of seeded data. Own-store bucket=today proves the Zid 6h sync path is being read.
Banner correctly accepts and surfaces the relative time 'Next crawl in X hrs' from /scheduler/status; stale-count fraction (11/13) is derived from the stores[] array on the client.
Minor a11y / HTML validity: button-inside-button warning needs fixing (see action_items). Browsers tolerate this but React 18+ logs a hydration warning.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 pages render banner with correct testids, bucket, expand behavior, and per-store rows)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded data. Competitor crawls are 36-70 days old, so banner legitimately shows 'stale' on red background (expected per spec).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 16 verified: (1) GET /api/data-freshness endpoint matches spec, (2) DataFreshnessBanner renders identically on /, /price-intel, /scanner with per-store rows testid'd as freshness-store-{store_id}, (3) my-products SKU/barcode search now correct via re.escape + $or-on-barcode. Only outstanding issue is a nested-button DOM warning inside DataFreshnessBanner — refresh-btn is rendered inside the toggle-btn. Functionality unaffected but logs a console error on every page load. No backend issues. Banner WILL show red 'stale' state until competitor crawls are re-run — this is expected.
rca of the issue: Nested-button warning RCA: In DataFreshnessBanner.jsx around line 146 (toggle button) the refresh button at line 191 is rendered as a child of the toggle's <button> element. Fix: lift the refresh button out of the toggle, e.g. wrap the toggle+refresh in a <div> and make them siblings, or use <div role='button' tabIndex={0} onClick={...} onKeyDown={enter/space}> for the outer expand region. No backend bugs to RCA — search fix and freshness endpoint both verified to be working correctly with real data.
